summary: Agents can ask a person independently while continuing claimed work. Omitting --step creates an agent-owned ask; --new-run optionally names it, and --step still explicitly blocks the named work. Independent asks survive idle turns and the end of the requester's owning work. Answered asks cannot subsequently be cancelled by owner-ended cleanup.

replay.detail: No graph replay is required. Existing independent asks also stop depending on owner-run liveness.

compatibility.detail: Independent asks consume no agent work capacity. Unnamed asks retain their identity across requester re-declarations; named asks preserve their pre-upgrade identity tuple. Stopping or retiring a requester permanently fences its old asks, including after re-declaration. Older daemons still require --new-run and may cancel managed requesters' asks when their owning work ends. Step-bound refusals now name the step, claim state and corrective action.

recovery.detail: Withdrawal, answers and configured deadline defaults retain their existing commands and behavior.
